results.detail: Unit 1, step 1, is correct against get Gen_employercare SQL DTSX:1425-1432 and Get All Transaction DTSX:1364-1368. Problem (a), unit 1, step 2: 'מסנכרנת ... את איש התפעול מתוך חשבון המעסיק (account.gen_operationperson) כשהוא שונה' is not exact. The SQL (DTSX:6772-6779) selects only when gen_employeroperationpersonname != a.gen_operationperson OR (gen_employeroperationpersonname is null AND a.gen_operationperson is not null). When the account value is NULL and the care record has a value, the two differ but the row is NOT selected. The package's own low finding ('ערך ריק בחשבון אינו מתפשט / ללא ניקוי') says this, so the summary contradicts it. Also, gen_employeroperationpersonname is unqualified in that query (ec / a), and the component's own open question marks its ownership as השערה; the summary presents it as the care record's value. Correct wording: 'כשבחשבון המעסיק מוגדר איש תפעול והוא שונה מהערך בעמודה gen_employeroperationpersonname שנשלפה (עמודה לא מסויגת; לפי ההשערה של הטיפול), או שהערך הזה ריק; ריק בחשבון אינו מנקה'. Smaller point in step 1: the summary does not mention the second attribute written with the state, gen_modifiedbybank = DateTime.Now (Update employer care main.cs:133). Problem (b), unit 2, count: 'מתוך 5 כותבי הסקריפט, 2 עסקיים ו-3 מסגרת' is not exact. There are 8 script-based SDK writers: 5 data-flow script components (Update employer care, Update CustomerCare, ETL Warning x2, ETL Record Finish) plus 3 Script Tasks that write gen_etlprocess/annotation (Create ETL Process record DTSX:2669; Error ETL Process record x2 in the OnError handlers, DTSX:247/256 and 5689/5698). Say '5 רכיבי סקריפט כותבים בזרימות הנתונים' or add the 3 framework Script Tasks. The rest of unit 2 is verified: single connection manager [CRM] (DTSX:6), EnableConfig=True, ConfigurationType=1 C:\Generix\SSISConfigFile.dtsConfig, all SQL is SELECT, no Execute SQL task, business writes are ExecuteMultiple Update of gen_employercare.

results.detail: The constraints at DTSX:7925-7928 are all default Success with no expressions: Get Organization Variables -> Create ETL Process record -> Close Gen_employercare -> Update operation person -> End ETL Process record. Nothing is disabled. The two OnError handlers (framework) are not listed, which is acceptable. The step-3 title is labelled with its sources (code comment / component name).

Get All Transaction is a full-cache lookup on gen_fundmainid = gen_fundnumber over gen_ftcurrentyear JOIN Gen_fundtransactiontype WHERE gen_transgrouptype = 1 AND gen_transactiontypeid NOT LIKE '%99%' GROUP BY gen_fundnumber. There is no date or employer column. The source joins every Gen_fundmain of the care record's customer account. gen_employername is not used. 'Current year' is labelled as a hypothesis. On ownership: gen_fundnumber is gen_ftcurrentyear's (qualified as gen_ftcurrentyear.gen_fundnumber in 0009/0015). gen_transactiontypeid is unqualified. The ambiguity rule plus 0008 'Get trans type name' (Gen_TransactionTypeID selected from gen_fundtransactiontype JOIN gen_banks) places it on Gen_fundtransactiontype. Either way, the label 'קוד סוג התנועה' is neutral about the table.

Update employer care main.cs:164-169: ErrorBuffer.AddRow and Description are commented out. No other code adds rows to the Error output, so Union All receives none. An unhandled exception fails the component, and the Close Gen_employercare OnError handler (DTSX:34-41) runs Error ETL Process record. That handler updates gen_etlprocess (statuscode 277880001, runtime) and creates an annotation with System::ErrorDescription (ReadOnlyVariables, DTSX:236-256). The external CRM.Proxy is marked unknown. The text is conditional.

Close Gen_employercare -> Update operation person is a Success constraint (DTSX:7927). The operation-person SQL (DTSX:6772-6779) has no state filter, so care records moved to state 3 earlier in the run are eligible. Note: 'על כל רשומות טיפול המעסיק' means 'regardless of state'. The update still applies only to rows that pass the employer/operation-person condition.

title_he and short_he match the source SQL (state 2, reason NULL or not in 6,7,8,9,11, all funds of the customer account) and the lookup condition. flow[3]: Aggregate GROUP BY Gen_employercareid (AggregationType=0, DTSX:580). flow[4]: main.cs:132-133: OptionSetValue(3) with comment //Finished, and gen_modifiedbybank = DateTime.Now, with the meaning labelled השערה.
